fields.title: Product sunset: how to exit without burning trust
fields.keyTakeaway: A product is sunsetted based on pre-defined conditions, and users are offboarded according to a plan: timeframe, data migration, alternatives, money. A quiet shutdown costs more than the closure itself—it costs the reputation of the entire company.
fields.checkQuestion: A product decision has been made to sunset it in three months. What will you do on day one?
fields.blocks/0/text: The key question of this node: **how to reduce the risks of exiting the market?** This is the most uncomfortable node in the domain and the least discussed in advance.
fields.blocks/1/items/0: **Signals**—what must happen for us to admit it failed: threshold not reached in so many months, unit economics don't work out, market shifted.
fields.blocks/1/items/1: **Alternatives to sunsetting**—narrow down to a profitable niche, hand off to a partner, switch to maintenance-only mode, sell.
fields.blocks/1/items/2: **Cost of continuation**—not just money, but team focus taken away from the core product.
fields.blocks/1/items/3: **Who decides and when**—the review date is set in advance, otherwise the product lingers on inertia for years.
fields.blocks/2/items/0: **Tell them first**—directly, via email, with an exact date. Rumors and silence are worse than any news.
fields.blocks/2/items/1: **Give time**—usually at least a quarter for business tools.
fields.blocks/2/items/2: **Give access to data**—export in a clear format, with no conditions or limits.
fields.blocks/2/items/3: **Suggest next steps**—your own alternative product or honest advice on a third-party tool.
fields.blocks/2/items/5: **Employees**—their future is addressed first, before any announcement to clients.
fields.blocks/3/text:
Condition set a year ago: 300 paying customers in the first year. Actual result—58.

Alternatives: selling failed, no niche found, support required two dedicated people full-time.

Plan: email to all 58 clients four months before shutdown, document export in a standard format, refund of advance payments for the remaining period, a list of two third-party services explaining which fits whom.

Out of 58 clients, 12 migrated to Reestr's main product. There was not a single public complaint; two clients sent thank-you messages for giving advance notice.
fields.blocks/3/title: Reestr sunsets the HR document module
fields.blocks/4/text: A product that is formally alive but left unfixed slowly destroys trust in the entire company. An honest sunset with a plan is almost always better than an endless agony.
fields.blocks/5/text: A product manager rarely makes the sunset decision alone: it carries commitments, contracts, and reputation. Your job is to present the conditions, alternatives, and cost of continuation so that the decision is made deliberately.
